construction: The inherited journey is the spine. Each room-boundary event from study 0005 places one short line fragment at its exact crossing point. That fragment follows the event's local hinge axis, perpendicular to the path's travel direction, and remains fixed at ninety degrees. Crossed rooms activate in sequence and revealed fragments remain along the spine like twigs on a branch.
invariants: the inherited 64-state path and 83 threshold events
the exact threshold crossing points and event order
one abstract line fragment per event
every fragment perpendicular to its local travel direction
no butterfly body, paired wings, flap, or angle interpolation
changes: the active and previously visited rooms
the number of revealed threshold fragments
eased position along each unchanged path segment
camera orbit and rigid upward presentation

motion_contract.spine: smoothstep position along each inherited segment
motion_contract.fragments: appear whole at the exact threshold crossing and never rotate
